syncFailureBanner.twoFaHelper: Some banks (notably Yahav) block scraping when 2FA is on. Disable it on the bank side and try again.

syncErrors.botBlocked: The bank's bot protection blocked this sync. It usually clears after a few hours (often overnight). Wait and try again.
syncErrors.isracardIdMismatch: Isracard rejected your ID and card combination. Check that the 'Last 6 digits of your card' field holds the last 6 digits of your card number, not your ID. You can fix it in the bank settings.
syncErrors.emptyResponse: The bank returned an empty response. This is usually temporary rate limiting on their side. We'll retry automatically; if it keeps failing, wait a few minutes and try again.
syncErrors.network: Network error reaching the bank. Check your connection and try again.
syncErrors.slowSite: The bank's site took too long to respond. This is often temporary; try again in a minute.
syncErrors.invalidPassword: The bank rejected the credentials. Check your ID, card last 6 digits and password.
syncErrors.changePassword: The bank is asking you to change your password. Log in on the bank's website first.
syncErrors.accountBlocked: The bank has blocked the account. Resolve this on the bank's website.
syncErrors.timeout: The sync timed out. The bank's site may be slow or down. Try again.
syncErrors.twoFactor: This account is asking for 2FA. For most banks, turn on 'This account requires 2FA' in the bank settings so Spent shows the browser and you can complete it. For One Zero, make sure the phone number is set.
syncErrors.unexpected: The sync failed unexpectedly. Turn on 'Show browser during sync' in settings to see what's happening.
syncErrors.unexpectedHeadless: The sync failed unexpectedly. The bank may have changed its login page. Try again later; if it keeps failing, update Spent.

data.title: Data & privacy
data.description: Spent runs locally. Your credentials are encrypted at rest and never leave your machine.
data.showBrowserHint: Opens a visible Chromium window so you can watch the scrape happen (useful for debugging or solving 2FA / captcha challenges). Also enables verbose scraper logs in your dev terminal.

data.storageCardDescription: Bank credentials and your Claude API key are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The encryption key lives at data/.encryption-key on your machine (gitignored) and is auto-generated on first run. All transaction data lives in data/spent.db. To reset everything, stop the dev server and delete the data/ directory.
data.excludedDescription: Merchants whose future transactions are automatically excluded from all spending totals. Excluded transactions still appear in the list, faded.
data.dangerDescription: Wipes every synced transaction, sync run, and merchant-memory entry. Your bank credentials, AI settings, budgets, and categories stay put. Use this to start over from a clean slate. Cannot be undone.
data.confirmKeeps: Kept: bank credentials, AI configuration, budgets, categories.
